criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 22 July 2028 (18 months after the 22 January 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Juniper Logistics plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Yarrow Capital LLP recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Juniper Logistics plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (22 July 2028), with days remaining from 18 December 2026 (582 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
